name: Globular Purkinje layer interneuron (globular cell / glycinergic globular cell)
anatomy_mentioned: Purkinje layer / Purkinje cell layer border
located just below / underneath the Purkinje cell layer
soma extends into the granular layer
long axon running mainly in the transverse axis (parallel to folial axis), spanning neighboring microzones
morphology_summary: Rare, small-bodied inhibitory interneuron with a rounded (globular) soma positioned at the underside of the Purkinje cell layer, extending into the granular layer. Most distinctive feature is a long axon running mainly in the transverse direction (parallel to the folial axis), unlike candelabrum cells whose axons ascend locally in a sagittal plane. Morphology is neither classic Golgi, nor classic Lugaro, nor molecular-layer basket/stellate; can be mistaken for small Golgi or fusiform Lugaro cells unless carefully examined.
ephys_summary: Silent at rest. Receives very prominent spontaneous IPSCs (highest frequency ~50-60 Hz and largest amplitude among the small granular-layer interneuron classes vs small Golgi and small fusiform Lugaro cells), including monosynaptic inhibitory input from Purkinje cell axon collaterals. Recruited by neuromodulators: fires in response to both serotonin (5-HT) and noradrenaline. Likely receives excitatory monosynaptic mossy-fiber input. Lower input resistance / less excitable than candelabrum cells. Sits in a Purkinje-cell feedback loop integrating PC collateral inhibition with mossy-fiber excitation under monoaminergic modulation.
subtypes_noted: No subtypes of the globular cell itself are described. The report situates the globular cell within the broader Purkinje-layer/rare-interneuron landscape: transcriptomic atlases define eight cerebellar inhibitory interneuron clusters (MLI1 [MLI1_1, MLI1_2], MLI2, Golgi1, Golgi2, CC/candelabrum, PLI2, PLI3). Globular/glycinergic (GLC) cells are mapped to the remaining PLI2 / GLC-like class by marker logic (PLI1=candelabrum cells, PLI3=Lugaro cells via Htr2a+Slc6a5). Clearly distinguished from candelabrum cells (Oxtr-Cre+, Aldh1a+, sagittal ascending axon), Lugaro cells (Htr2a+), Golgi cells, and molecular-layer basket/stellate cells.
